title.en: The Fall of the Galactic Imperium

texts.zh:
自由重新回到了全星系！星海帝国终于陨落了，最后一个帝制派也向日益壮大的义军投降了。

随着[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]被罢黜，过去的星海共同体重回生机。时间将会证明重建起的制度是否能够防止下一位星系独裁者的诞生，但现在，过去帝国的疆域里的各个行星上同时掀起了庆祝活动。
texts.en:
Freedom has been restored to the galaxy! The Galactic Imperium has fallen, and the last of the Imperial loyalists have surrendered to the advancing Rebel forces.

With the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] deposed, the old Galactic Community has been resurrected. Time will tell if the reborn institution can prevent the rise of another galactic dictator, but for now, spontaneous celebrations have broken out on planets across the territory of the former Imperium.

label.en: This is a day to remember.

title.en: The Fall of the Galactic Imperium

texts.zh:
星海帝国已经陷落了。我们帝国军队无力阻挡叛乱舰队进犯的步伐，而今天，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]也别无选择停止了抵抗。

随着帝国的解体，星海共同体的腐朽机构又重新开始运作了。于是，星系又毅然决然地背离了秩序而拥抱了混沌……
texts.en:
The Galactic Imperium has fallen. Imperial forces proved unable to stop the advance of the Rebel fleets, and today the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] had no choice but to capitulate.

With the Imperium dismantled, the old corrupt institution of the Galactic Community has been resurrected to take its place. And so the galaxy has turned decisively away from order, and embraced chaos...

title.en: The Fall of the Galactic Imperium

texts.zh:
在叛军四面楚歌的围攻下，星海帝国陨落了。叛乱的渣滓们竟击败了帝国曾经强大无比的舰队，最后一位帝制派也背弃了我们的伟业。

迫于一切帝制派抵抗分子的瓦解，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]别无选择只能退位。叛党们已经宣布过去的星海共同体再次启用，以填补帝国分崩离析后的巨大真空。
texts.en:
Beset by traitors on all sides, the Galactic Imperium has fallen. The rebel scum have broken the Imperium's once-powerful fleets, and the last of the loyalists have deserted our cause.

In light of the collapse of all Imperial resistance, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has had no choice but to abdicate. The insurgents have already announced the resurrection of the old Galactic Community to fill the great void left by the disintegrating Imperium.

title.en: The Fall of the Galactic Imperium

texts.zh:
星海帝国陨落了。随着起义军在各个战线全面开花，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]最终退位。

旧的星海共同体重新恢复了运作以替代分崩离析的帝国。
texts.en:
The Galactic Imperium has fallen. With Rebel forces victorious on all fronts, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has abdicated.

The old Galactic Community has been restored in the collapsing Imperium's stead.
